nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Matte Sunscreen - SPF 45

avis.texte: I use this sunscreen with my travel skin regimen that doesn't include products with SPF coverage. The sunscreen lives up to its name because it is truly matte with no white residue. A little bit goes a long way, so don't let the small tube discourage you from purchasing. Excellent product!!.

avis.titre: Sort of great for eyeglass wearers!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is matte and it needs to be shaken because the product separates. There's a slight chemical smell, since it's a chemical sunscreen. It did sting my eyes and it did keep my eyeglasses from slipping for a bit. I plan to repurchase this in the future!

I absolutely love this brand sunscreen. I buy all three sunscreens original, matte, and kids to use for my day to day. The application is smooth to apply and there's no white reside. I will be buying more for me and my family to use. Both photos show matte with using makeup and the original without makeup. Perfection for my face.

I was advised to use a high SPF (up to 50) facial moisturizer for a discoloration on my face, so I use this product daily to even skin tone. It has been working fine though can be a little heavy when the weather is warmer. A little goes a long way.
It is the perfect sunscreen for me. It's light and moisturizes the skin. I love it and wear it everyday.

avis.titre: Make it Matte is my least favorite product by BGS
avis.texte: Make it Matte (MIM) was a pass for me This product is not for the body, it's only for the face. Unlike the moistening sunscreen lotions, MIM burns my eyes if I apply it on my eyelids or if water gets on my face.This does NOT happen with the lotions

avis.titre: NO CHALKY WHITE FILM ON BLACK SKIN
avis.texte: I am a black women. I am not familiar with sunscreen products at all. I have never used sunscreen before. However, now that I am older I need a prescription menopause face cream and My doctor recommended I use a sunscreen on my face as the last step with my Estradiol Face Cream to protect my skin because the use of estrogen + niacinamide + tretinoin cream will make my skin sensitive to sun rays. I purchased popular expensive Name brand face Sunscreen with SPF and they all leave a very visible chalky white film on my skin and makes my face look a horrible dull grey! I am very disappointed because their website specifically states that it will NOT leave a white cast on my skin but it did. Obviously, those products was Not made with black women in mind. I do not wear makeup/ foundation cream. I was in search for a face sunscreen I can worn alone. I AM SO GRATEFUL THAT I FOUND BLACK GIRL SUNSCREEN! The Make It Matte 45 gel face sunscreen is perfect! It glides on smoothly. Just a little goes along way. After washing my face I apply a small amount and it makes my skin feel so soft and gives my face a wonderful Glow! No makeup, No foundation cream just my own natural beautiful brown skin. It does not leave a chalky white film on my skin. It does Not turn my face dull and grey like other sunscreens. I can wear it alone on its own or layered on top of my Estrogen Face Cream. FINALLY A LINE IF SUNSCREEN PRODUCTS FORMULATED TO NOURISH AND PROTECT BLACK PEOPLE MELANATED BROWN SKIN - I LO

Originally bought it to test as my local target has not restocked in like a month plus. I'm oily so it works well for me. I also like that its translucent. Also, it doesn't make my eyes water which is a pleasant surprise. I love it!
The sunscreen is not heavy and is light when I put it on my face!!

I have been using Make it Matte for over a year and I absolutely love it. The way it feels when applied and how it holds its matte finish under my makeup is phenomenal. It is the perfect blend of protection and primer for me. I will be purchasing my 3rd tube in the very near future. Thank you BGS!

avis.titre: Happy I tried it , it's meh
avis.texte: I'm a tan girl & love trying sunscreen . This one is for those no makeup days . It does not wear well under makeup. It's totally clear , wasn't a see to that . Anyway I will not purchase it again or recommend it.
I've always used black girl sunscreen and my hyperpigmentation is much better because of it . Definitely in my skincare routine to stay 🤗

avis.titre: Blends In Well - Not Sure If Its Actually Matte
avis.texte: This lasts all day on me. It blends in great with no white cast. It tingles at first and is a bit more shiny than I expected for matte. Overall, it is my go-to sunscreen for right now and definitely can give glass skin effect.
every new bottle I have ever had has been greasy no matter how much I shake it

I brought after searching for a sunscreen for my oily/combination skin. This makes me extremely oily and shiny. I dont use a lot and this still happens. It was suggested for me to use because it is supposed to mattify but that definitely didnt happen for me
Love this face sunscreen. It never leaves a cast and it's perfect for everyday wear.
BEST Part: smooth matte finish WORST Part: too many ingredients for my sensitive skin

avis.titre: Not All it's Cracked Up to Be
avis.texte: After a poor experience with BGS Kids, I tried switching to the Make It Matte formula. I tend to be very oily especially when wearing sunscreen, so I was excited to try something that wouldn't give me a white cast and make me look greasy. The formula is very similar to the SuperGoop sunscreen that's gone viral as it has a silicone smooth texture that feels like it creates a film on top of the skin. While I will say the first few days of testing the product out I did stay less greasy for longer but eventually, the grease did appear especially in my t-zone. Reapplication only made the oiliness worse, I noticed that the product moves throughout the day. Even when I avoid areas closely around my mouth and eyes, I feel it slide into those places almost within 30 minutes of applying the product. This happens even when I'm not sweating or doing any activity that would cause this. After almost 9 days of using the product I started to get an irritation rash around my eyes and on the tops of my cheeks. Sad about the turn out of this product, and I'm out of my money on top that!
I really like the smell and the matte function of this sunscreen. There's nothing worse than have an oily face.

I frequently work in yard and in the garden at my church. The Make It Matte SPF 45 Sunscreen is protecting my face from the effects of extreme temperatures and piercing sunlight. Your product lives up to its promises and my face has not suffered any sun damage.

While putting on my face it was a little difficult to smear on face because of the "silcone" but once I put the product on my eyelids the burn increasingly became worse. It took about 5-10 mins of washing out my eye area to remove the burn. NOT WORTH the $$
I have been using Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Matte for over a year. I absolutely love the finish.

avis.titre: love for my combination and sensitive skin
avis.texte: Love it because I have combination and sensitive skin. So the matte look helps my skin not be oily and helps does not break out my skin. I use the BlackGirl Sunscreen for the body when I am going to be in high heat.

avis.titre: Shirt finish. . . . & plays well with makeup.
avis.texte: I typically prefer much higher SPF levels in my sunscreen, but 45 was all I saw available here. I've not been using it as often as I should, but I do love that I can apply it to my face without any burning or stinging. Also the matte finish is a game changer! I'm remembering to shake before applying the gel though, because it does separate a little. I'll likely only be using this in my face, given the price point & small size of the tube.
I bought this sunscreen to use on my tattoo sleeves. Regular sunscreen can make them look cloudy! I loved it so much I bought some for my face. I love it!

avis.titre: Love this for its dual benefits
avis.texte: This has been my favorite facial sunscreen primarily because: (1) I love that it mattifies my face because I can get a little shiny. It is especially wonderful before makeup application. (2) I love that there is NO white cast. (3) Wearing it regularly has helped my face blemishes fade away. I learned how much sunscreen helps in that process. And how not wearing it can make the marks darker or last longer. I find that the tube goes a long way. Sometimes, it has separated a bit but I just try to squish it to mix it when that happens. More pros than cons for sure. I love BGS!
Absolutely love this product. There was no white cast and it kept me from getting sunburned even after spending all day on the water. Definitely a must buy.
This is a great sunscreen- leaves no white cast! I Highly recommend.
Perfect every day wear. It goes on smooth and there's no greasy or sticky feel. Perfect under make up too.
This is the first time I did not burn using sunscreen. The matte felt light when applying.
Black Girl Sunscreen is the only sunscreen that I use. It doesn't leave a white cast on my face. I like that it has a matte finish.

I like the transparency of the SPF 45 Sunscreen better than the SP:F 50, which can leave a pale residue on the skin making it look a little ashy. But still, it is better than any other Sunscreen brand I have tried. Thank you for giving us something that works on Black Girl skin!
Its the best sunscreen ever made for POC . . . no white film on the skin . . . leaves a dewy non greasy look and goes on smoothly like a skin moisturizer. . . .

avis.titre: As long as I have skin I will use this
avis.texte: I have covered up and stayed out of the sun my whole life because every sunscreen left a white film or made my makeup lighter. Finally I found not only a sunscreen that does not leave a white cast, but is matte so my face does not look greasy. Bonus this sunscreen is also a great primer. Ive have told everyone I know about this sunscreen, finally one made for our skin.

avis.titre: Yes It's Really 'That Good' and You Should Go Ahead and Try
avis.texte: I REALLY love this sunscreen. It's lightweight, CLEAR, doesn't feel sticky—doesn't feel at all once it dries. It's amazing. I can't wait to try the other one. I highly recommend. Makeup wearers: you won't find a better sunscreen to go under your makeup.
I love this stuff!!!! The application is smooth you don't have to work to apply it, there is no residue, and my face feel is moisturized without feeling greasy.
Let me tell you this product is A1. It doesn't leave a cast and it keeps you moisturized!

Even with vigorously shaking this product comes out partially gelled and partially liquid, so I dont trust the SPF stated on the bottle because you cant uniformly mixit. I also put some in a travel container and it completely separated with a firm gel lump surrounded by oily liquid.

I use this formula when I wear makeup plus the finish gives no shine which I prefer when I wear makeup. I didn't see where this interfered with the formula of my foundation gives a matte finish as suggested. I always purchase this.
It keeps me from looking extra oily, but it doesn't stay matte all day.
Very good sunscreen. It feels kinda of like a light gel that quickly absorbs ínto the skin. I noticed no coloration effects on my skin. My skin is light brownish and it did not leave any residue.
This is the best sunscreen that I have ever used. It feels good on my skin and I always get compliments, thank you!
No white cast! This product goes on with ease smoothly so far my favorite sunscreen
Excellent! I'm more than pleased! No residue no grease just leaves my skin smooth and nearly perfect.
This is my daily holy grail. I always get compliments on my skin and it balances glow and matte along with moisturizes making me feel younger.
I put it on before I leave home, and it never leaves any kind of residue under my make-up!
Just used this on a trip to St. Lucia, where the sun was INTENSE! Wonderful results and absolutely NO burn. Great sun protection and left my skin feeling soft and moisturized!
I wanted to like this so bad because I tried the mineral formula, but this caused my skin to react so badly that I had to exchange it for something else.

If you're used to slugging or remember when your mother used to put Vaseline on your face in the winter to protect you from the elements then this will give you the same feel. I'm going to use it as a winter moisturizer because it goes on light but becomes really greasy.
So far so good. I haven't been getting a great deal of sun exposure since it's now Autumn. However, I do like wearing it under my makeup and I'm certainly a believer. Good on you all!

I love this product as a black women with melanted skin. I usually had a problem with white over cast, breakouts,and looking ashy. Yet this sunscreen goes on clear and cover my pores. It works as a primer covering all flaws on my face.I have combination skin
I use the original, hybrid and matte. I really like the matte when I wear makeup. Of course there is no cast with the matte or the others. Great products.

I developed really bad photocontact dermatitis when I wore this in the sun. Severe swelling, blisters, red and crusty, itchy skin. Octocrylene ingredient is known irritant apparently. Stick to mineral sunscreens.

I love the way this product feels! I was expecting a typical white, heavy cream but instead this lovely silky-soft clear emulsion that completely absorbed into my skin. Excellent protection in an elegant way!

avis.titre: Black Matte is where it's at!
avis.texte: I love the Black Matte sunscreen and how it feels on my skin. It has helped to reverse the skin damage I had from pimples on my face.

I understand and know how inportant sunscreen is, but it was difficult to stick to it due to the white cast. I'm so happy I found BGS, finally no white cast. All of them work well. And I use all of them. I use the matte under make-up.
I love the protection and hydration My girl sunscreen provides without leaving a white mass or cast on the face

Overall the product is ok. No white cast as promised and you can wear makeup over it. It doesn't finish matte in my opinion, it has more of a dewy finish, which i don't necessarily care for having an oily skin combo. Customer service is great! Product is worth a try!

I'm loving this sunscreen! I've been searching for a face sunscreen that doesn't leave the dreaded white cast. I've found it. This sunscreen is a sheer, lightweight gel. It is fragrance free and absorbs into the skin quickly. It does have shea butter and coconut oil, which may be a problem for those with oily skin.

This is a great product that is comfortable to wear and won't leave a cast. If you sweat it won't run and become white. A little provides good coverage. It's scentless so it's perfect for when you wear your own scent/parfum. I am super happy with BGS

avis.titre: I really wanted to like it
avis.texte: I love supporting black owned businesses especially in skin care. quite often our skin is not considered with product formulation. I would much rather spend my money with a company that's being intentional. with that said I love the clear application. never an issue with a white cast. goes well as a first layer before makeup and no pilling. downsides are for me as someone with combination skin and acne prone I do not do well with this sunscreen especially in the summertime. my face just kind of stays oily and greasy. for someone with dry skin or who isn't acne prone it would probably appear as a nice glow for them. for me it's just greasy and I feel like my summer breakouts never go away. so if you have the right skin type this could be a great SPF for you. if you're acne prone with combo skin I recommend to keep looking.
No residue. Glowing skin. Light weight. Protects from sun. No brainer purchase.

This product makes my skin glow on good and bad days. Maintaining that glow and moisture is what I need to keep that fresh feel facial. Highly recommend for all my minimal product use girlies who want to proceed their skin without having to worry about residue (because this one is clear) and glow.
No white cast which is great. Definitely NOT matte. Leaves skin VERY shiny/greasy. Smells fibe.
This sunscreen is completely clear and very effective. There is no fragrance and it is smooth going on, like a primer. Feels good to have a sunscreen without the white cast.

avis.titre: Where has this been all my life!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the coverage and texture of this product. I break out easily, so I'm hesitant to try new products on my face.

Yes, I do indeed buy this product regularly for a few years because it's just that good. This sunscreen goes on smoothly and vanishes quickly without leaving an ashy appearance. After it dries, apply your favorite SPF moisturizer and blend. BGS is the best sunscreen I've ever tried.
I absolutely love this sunscreen. It's so smooth on my skin and mixes well with my other skincare products! It also does well with my eczema, I recommend this.
I love this sunscreen! On my deeper complexion it gives me a very nice matte finish and glow. It is the last thing I put on my when I leave out the door Every Day.

avis.titre: Feels great and doesn't leave a residue
avis.texte: This feels really nice on my skin. I put it on after I moisturize in the mornings. Sometimes put foundation on top. I like the light feel and the nearly matte finish.

avis.titre: I really want to love it
avis.texte: I'm not sure what is in this peoduct but it causes my eyes to burn

I absolutely loooove this product!!! Now tht summer is approaching, I was perspiring waaaay too much with the Cerave Ultra Light Mositurizing Lotion, so I inquired my dermatologist of a moisturizer/sunscreen that would prevent me from sweating, and he recommended the 'Black Girl Sunscreen'. It's the best of the best!!! Unlike other sunscreens I've tried, this doesn't leave a white cast, it just leaves my chocolate skin so smooth, and glowy!! I've lost count of how many I've already ordered and continue to order!!!
Absolutely fantastic. I bought two bottles of this and the lip gloss! Genius!!! Really fantastic!

I liked this sunscreen, it did everything it was supposed to. As expected, there was 0 whitecast. A problem was that I felt it wasn't as good of a deal as their other sunscreens which provide more product and costs less, which was rather annoying. Additionally, the texture was rather annoying and felt very watery while leaving a greasy finish. I would recommend the moisturizing lotion version of this sunscreen since it leaves a beautiful finish and costs less.

In the morning, all I use is the Make It Matte Sunscreen. No serums, no toners. My esthetician is always amazed at how nice my skin looks. I do not wear foundation, so I can't speak to how it performs with it. I live in Arizona so I do look a bit oily by the end of the day, but I also have an oily skin type. Either way, my skin is glowing and this is a staple. I recommend it to everybody.

I'm glad I decided to purchase this sunscreen dispite the mid reviews I've seen for this product. It goes on like a dream! It's a gel yhat dries done to a matte finish that's not at all ashy. Compared to Supergoop, which for some reason gets highly rated, this product works with my makeup without turning it into a complete oil slick. I also tried BeautyStat universal C skin refiner vitamin c serum + SPF 50 sunscreen. It's almost 4x the price and it is an absolute ash fest!

My skin is super sensitive. I have combination skin. I also have hormonal Melasma. This sunscreen is the only one that gives me the less shine and no irritation. It has been part of my daily routine for over a year now. before I was using the Make it Hybrid. I always keep 1 reserve (just in case of inventory shortage in my area).
Confident sun protection and applied over a good oily skin moisturizer, keeps my extremely oily skin matte throughout most of the day. Easy to reapply too! This is my favorite facial sunscreen ever!
Product goes on light and leaves your skin with a healthy looking glow that's not greasy. Love it.
Great I used this curing a cruise and came out with a beautiful sunlit bronze color and no burning. Absolutely love this product
I love the sunscreen, just wish it came in larger quantities as I use it daily.
I just wrote a review...sighting overall happy my sunscreen arrived
I love the SPF 45! It goes on smooth and brightens my skin. No film left from the product. Sisters order this Sunscreen made for us. Support Black Businesses

avis.titre: Great sunscreen, lasts a long time.
avis.texte: I love the gel texture of this. I didn't love the smell, which was a bit chemical. I thought it took a little too long to dry into the skin and sometimes got in the way of the rest of my morning makeup and skincare routine. But it was great to share with my family on a trip to convince everyone to wear sun protection.

I have oily/combination skin and the occasional acne prone and this suncreen is the best after trying others as a dark skin black girl and ive been using it for 2 years now. No white cast, a matte finish so imm not greasy looking. A little goes a long way all the way down to my neck which is plus. And it can be worn inder your makeup without interfering with your other products.
Great product. First time trying this version, I've used the 30 SPF numerous times.
Great texture, love the matte feeling, application is just prefect. Great results

I love this sunscreen. It's all I use. It was difficult to find a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast so I was thrilled to find this. I've tried the supergoop unseen sunscreen as well but that one clogs my pores which lead to a lot of break out's and my esthetician said this one had better ingredients. I also just wanted to support a black owned business so I'm glad they did not disappoint. Only con in my opinion is I feel like I need more of this than other sunscreens. Its a little hard to rub in but still worth it to me. The bottle is tiny but you would be surprised how long it last. I reapply my sunscreen 3-4 times a day and this bottle is still half full after 5 months. Every black and brown person needs this!
Silky smooth finish, not greasy at all. Most importantly, my face did not shine like a light bulb!!!! Love it

I have cystic acne and get red at times. I get shiny a lot. I have tried every single sunscreen out there. Nothing has ever worked for me except this one. I never write reviews but had to for this. Other sunscreens make me break out and leave me white and shiny. This one I have been using now for about four months, no breakouts at all. Keeps my skin from getting shiny though out the day. I even use at night before applying my makeup to keep the shine away. It keep my powder looking good all night. I love love love this product and definitely recommend to anyone who has skin like mine. Trust me you will love it.

avis.titre: Not for sensitive or oily skin
avis.texte: Let's start with the positives. As a Black woman I like that this sunscreen doesn't leave a white overcast on my skin. The gel formula is also thick and creates a smooth surface for makeup. I wanted to love this product but just threw it away due to breakouts! I typically have clear skin and since using this product I have had several breakouts. I suffer from hyperpigmentation so I'm not looking forward to recovering from this acne. I have sensitive skin and there's a 50/50 chance my face would tingle after applying. I just started using a new toner so wanted to see which product was causing this reaction, and it's the sunscreen. In the first paragraph I mentioned how the formula creates a smooth foundation for makeup. However, this sunscreen would leave me face SUPER GREASY! I've never had to blot so much even when I didn't follow up with makeup (which is most days). This product separates and I wasn't aware that I had to shake it the first few days. I was basically applying an oily liquid to my face (when I got the first big breakout). Despite shaking the product and getting the actual correct consistency, I'm still breaking out.

I was very impressed with this sunscreen. I like that it's a clear gel formula, so I don't have to worry about it making my skin look ashy. I have oily skin, so I really love that it is also matte. It's nice and lightweight and I like that it's also good for my skin. I give it 5 stars and would recommend.
Pleased with sunscreen. No residue left after applying. Would recommend to anyone

I absolutely loooove this product!!! Now tht summer is approaching, I was perspiring waaaay too much with the Cerave Ultra Light Mositurizing Lotion, so I inquired my dermatologist of a moisturizer/sunscreen that would prevent me from sweating, and he recommended the 'Black Girl Sunscreen'. It's the best of the best!!! Unlike other sunscreens I've tried, this doesn't leave a white cast, it just leaves my chocolate skin so smooth, and glowy!! Will be ordering more very soon!!

I have a long and tortured history of trying to find the perfect sunscreen for both face and body, and this one comes quite close to hitting that mark but doesn't quite make it. Things I really like about it: It is unscented. It is truly a matte finish, no shine at all. It seems to work very well. I was recently on a vacation where I spent a lot of time outside in sunny places, and I didn't get any color or sunburn at all. (I am a white woman, with very fair skin) Things I don't like about it: it is very heavy on my skin. It feels greasy, even though it doesn't look greasy. It is v-e-r-y difficult to wash off! It is difficult to shake up before using. I am unsure of what the consistency is supposed to be, but each time I start to use it it comes out like an oil and I have to shake it vigorously to make it resemble the gel that I assume, based on the product description, it is supposed to be. I will most likely continue using this product, even with the aspects that I don't like, simply because I haven't found an alternative.
